sections.heading: Wealthbox buyer question and thesis
sections.body:
Advisor-focused CRM with Basic, Pro, and Premier per-user plans plus Enterprise custom pricing. That orientation decides whether this setup URL should exist separately from the Wealthbox hub.

Buyer question: choose Wealthbox only if Financial advisors and RIAs outweighs Priced and positioned for advisors — poor general SMB sales CRM fit — otherwise keep researching.

Verdict shape: yes for teams built around Financial advisors and RIAs; Wealth management client relationship teams; Firms needing advisor-oriented CRM workflows; no when General B2B SaaS sales teams; Budget SMB freemium buyers; Marketing automation platforms — contact management is the hinge, not brand familiarity.

Best for: Financial advisors and RIAs; Wealth management client relationship teams; Firms needing advisor-oriented CRM workflows (Financial advisors and RIAs).

Poor fit when: General B2B SaaS sales teams; Budget SMB freemium buyers; Marketing automation platforms. Avoid if Priced and positioned for advisors — poor general SMB sales CRM fit would block go-live.

sections.heading: Wealthbox limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Priced and positioned for advisors — poor general SMB sales CRM fit; Enterprise custom quote; Higher seat cost than mass-market SMB CRMs because it forces process changes or add-ons around Wealthbox when contact management is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on Basic with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain contact management at the expense of Published packaging clarity vs ecosystem depth — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Basic · contact management | Pro | Premier.

Alternative context: unlike Salesforce, Wealthbox is preferable when Financial advisors and RIAs because contact management plus contact management match; prefer Salesforce when General B2B SaaS sales teams because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Wealthbox
sections.body:
Scenario: for contact management teams, recommend Wealthbox when Financial advisors and RIAs; recommend an alternative path when General B2B SaaS sales teams because Priced and positioned for advisors — poor general SMB sales CRM fit dominates.

Implementation effort: setup takes a named admin for contact management plus a freeze window if integrations are in the cutover path.

Final call: proceed with Wealthbox when contact management plus contact management outweigh Priced and positioned for advisors — poor general SMB sales CRM fit; walk when General B2B SaaS sales teams because workarounds will eat the Basic spend.
